SRB.NoActor: Select a token you own and click refresh, or assign a character to your user. You can also open a specific Actor through the API.
SRB.NoResources: No resource definitions. The GM can create one in module settings.
SRB.TrackerHint: Hover a tick to inspect its threshold. Gold ticks mean this threshold was reached before. Turning a resource off pauses its tracking; it does not remove effects.
SRB.ResetHint: Set value to zero; keep sticky effects and threshold history.
SRB.TreatConfirm: Reset this resource, erase its history and remove only effects created by this resource?
SRB.Name: Name
SRB.Current: Active while value is at or above threshold
SRB.ChangesHint: Example AC penalty: [{"key":"system.attributes.ac.bonus","mode":2,"value":"-2"}]. Modes: 0 custom, 1 multiply, 2 add, 3 downgrade, 4 upgrade, 5 override. Only system.* keys are accepted.
SRB.ConfigHint: Definitions apply to all Actors. IDs stay stable. At maximum the terminal effect survives the zero reset. Treat affected Actors before deleting definitions; existing effects are not silently removed.
SRB.DeleteResourceConfirm: Delete this resource definition? Actor history and existing effects will be preserved. Treat affected Actors before deletion if you want their effects removed.
SRB.ItemRulesHint: Rules belong to this Item. Hit uses D&D5e attack results (or Midi-QOL); damage requires a positive native damage application with the original chat card. Do not add both hit and damage rules for the same bonus unless you want both to apply.
SRB.NoRules: No rules yet. Add a rule to increase a target's resource by 5 on hit.
SRB.AutomationHint: Process confirmed hits and applied-damage events. Manual API editing remains available when disabled.
SRB.TokenBarsHint: Owner/GM-only bars above tokens, without changing HP bars. Up to six resources are shown.
SRB.GMOnly: Only a GM can edit module configuration.
SRB.WrongSystem: Silverlane Resource Bars requires D&D5e 6.1+ on Foundry v14.
